snippet.title: Let Me Breathe | Mostafa Elsaadi (Lyric Video)
snippet.description:
🖤 LET ME BREATHE — Mostafa Elsaadi

Sometimes you don't need to explain yourself.
You don't need to be stronger.
You don't need to carry everything.

Sometimes you just need space.

“Let Me Breathe” is a powerful Luxury Soulful Afro House journey about breaking away from pressure, expectations, and the weight of always trying to be everything for everyone.

We spend so much of our lives saying yes.
Giving more.
Carrying more.
Trying to keep everyone happy.

Until one day, we realize we've forgotten to listen to ourselves.

This song is about that moment.

The moment you stop apologizing for needing space.
The moment you understand that choosing yourself isn't selfish.
The moment you finally hear your own heartbeat again.

You don't have to run.
You don't have to fight.

Just breathe.

Let yourself breathe.

Vaaroon Forever Lyrics :

Intro Chorus

Bandha nainon ne nainon se dora
Mohe kheenche chala moh tora
Tohe saunpa hai tan mann ye kora
Mohe thaame tu rakhna sada
My gaze is entangled to your gaze
And your love is tugging me towards you
I have surrendered my pristine self to you
Hold on to me forever

Verse 01

Vaaroon, vaaroon main vaaroon tori
Ab na jag ki hai parvaah koi
Thaam le tu mori jindagi
Tohse badh ke na koi khushi
I devote myself to you
No longer do I care for the world
Be the hands that hold my life
There’s no greater joy than you
Vaaroon vaaroon main vaaroon tori
Aaj saunpe hai sapne sabhi
Naina tore tijori mori
Hai mori
I devote myself to you
Today I handover all my dreams to you
Your eyes are my safe place

Chorus 01

Pheeka pheeka tha manwa ye mora
Chhoo ke toone bhara rang tora
Mele jaisa saja hai ye angana
Tohre aane se dil ka mora
My heart was so colourless n dull
Your touch filled it with (your) colours
My heart is adorned like a carnival
Ever since you came into my life

Verse 02

Vaaroon vaaroon main vaaroon tori
Tohse naata hai mora koi
Tu gagan main pawan hoon tori
Mori saansein bhi sab hain tori
I devote myself to you
There is a bond between us
If you are a sky, I am your wind
Every breath of mine is yours
Vaaroon vaaroon main vaaroon tori
Mohe aankho mein bhar le kahin
Tori khushiyon se dharkan mori
Hai mori
I devote myself to you
Let me dwell in your eyes somewhere
Your happiness makes my heart beat

Chorus 02

Tohse janamo ka phera hai mora
Tohri chhaaya mein mora basera
Tohre vaade pe sab kuchh luta doon
Moh pe rakhna bharosa zara
I have belonged to you across lifetimes
I reside in your shade
For your promise, I'd give my all
Have faith in me

Verse 03

Tore naaz saare utha loon, jo kahe
Ye naina more, more jaage hain sung tore
Har raat tori saja doon, jo kahe
Hain jeena mohe, mohe jeena hai sung tore
I’ll fulfil all your whims, if you wish
These eyes will stay awake with you
I’ll light up all your nights, if you wish
I want to live, I want to live beside you forever

Chorus 3

Tore aage main sir ko jhuka doon
Tore sapne palak pe bitha doon
Kaala teeka main tohe laga doon
Tohe laage nazar na zara
I’d bow my head before you,
Hold your dreams gently upon my eyes
Mark you with a little ward against the evil eye
May no ill ever fall upon you

snippet.description:
#Terminator7 #IronDawn #ConceptTrailer

Watch this TERMINATOR 7: IRON DAWN Concept Trailer and enter a chilling new future where the machines no longer need a nuclear war to take control.

Arnold Schwarzenegger returns as the Guardian, an aging machine hidden among humans for twenty years, while Amanda Seyfried leads the resistance as Commander Nora Voss.
Ryan Gosling stars as Sergeant Darius Cole, a soldier who discovers machine technology fused into his own spine, and Mads Mikkelsen becomes Veil, a terrifying Terminator built to manipulate rather than openly attack.
This What If concept introduces MERIDIAN, an advanced artificial intelligence silently taking over modern-day Prague through power grids, communications, transportation systems, and human infiltration.
As Veil tears the resistance apart from within, the Guardian reveals ECHO, a secret program capable of forcing every machine on Earth to question whether human life deserves to survive.

TERMINATOR 7: IRON DAWN imagines a darker evolution of the Terminator franchise with AI warfare, infiltration, cybernetic soldiers, resistance missions, and a massive final battle beneath Prague.
The story builds toward the Guardian's ultimate sacrifice as ECHO spreads through MERIDIAN's global network, leading to a haunting sixty seconds of silence before the machines begin shutting themselves down.
The original storyline, storyboard, character concepts, and visuals were personally created by me specifically for this What If concept trailer, including the Guardian, Veil, Darius, Nora, and the Iron Dawn storyline.
